en: Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square with children and adults in early‑20th‑century clothing, a horse‑drawn wagon, and small market stalls with umbrellas in the foreground. The square is surrounded by three‑ to four‑story historicist townhouses with shops on the ground floor. In the background are wooded hills with scattered buildings and a church tower. A corner building at right carries shop signage in German, including the name "Paul Wachsm…".
